name: inference-data
title: LLM inference measurements
description: Normalized, sourced measurements of LLM inference throughput, latency, and power, with the hardware, models, and publications they depend on. Empty cells mean unknown. Rates in tok/s are never invented.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Stable id. Pattern: lowercase words and hyphens.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Public https URL. Required.

fields.name: date_published
fields.description: Publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty if the page does not state a day.

fields.name: date_accessed
fields.description: Date this dataset recorded the page, YYYY-MM-DD. Required.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: benchmark, vendor, video, or post.

fields.name: memory_gb
fields.description: Memory capacity. Unit: GB. GPU memory when the device has a separate GPU pool; see notes.

fields.name: bandwidth_gb_s
fields.description: Memory bandwidth. Unit: GB/s.

fields.name: dense_bf16_fp16_tflops
fields.description: Dense BF16 or FP16 tensor throughput. Unit: TFLOPS. Notes say which format.

fields.name: fp4_tflops
fields.description: FP4 throughput. Unit: TFLOPS. Often the sparse headline; notes say if so.

fields.name: tdp_w
fields.description: Thermal design power or total graphics/system power as stated. Unit: W.

fields.name: launch_price_usd
fields.description: Launch price. Unit: USD.

fields.name: market_price_usd
fields.description: Market or list price observed on market_price_date. Unit: USD.

fields.name: market_price_date
fields.description: Date of market_price_usd, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: params_total_b
fields.description: Total parameters. Unit: billions.

fields.name: params_active_b
fields.description: Active parameters per token. Unit: billions. Equal to total for a dense model when both are stated.

fields.name: architecture
fields.description: dense, moe, unspecified, or empty if not stated.

fields.name: license
fields.description: SPDX or common license name. Empty if the cited source did not state it.

fields.name: hardware_id
fields.description: Empty if the device was not identified.

fields.name: hw_count
fields.description: How many of hardware_id were used. Empty if unknown.

fields.name: model_id
fields.description: Empty if the checkpoint was not identified.

fields.name: context_tokens
fields.description: Configured context window. Unit: tokens. Empty when the source only said a K-suffix or a range.

fields.name: input_tokens
fields.description: Prompt or ISL. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: output_tokens
fields.description: Generated or OSL length. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: concurrency
fields.description: Requests in flight.

fields.name: prefill_tok_s
fields.description: Prompt processing throughput. Unit: tok/s.

fields.name: decode_tok_s
fields.description: Aggregate decode throughput. Unit: tok/s.

fields.name: decode_tok_s_per_user
fields.description: Decode throughput per in-flight request, only when the source published it. Unit: tok/s.

fields.name: ttft_ms
fields.description: Time to first token. Unit: ms.

fields.name: power_w
fields.description: Measured power. Unit: W. Notes say GPU, socket, or wall.

fields.name: task_time_s
fields.description: Wall-clock time for a fixed workload such as AA-AgentPerf-Local. Unit: s. Empty for token-rate rows.

fields.name: cache_state
fields.description: warm, cold, uncached, or mixed. Empty when the source did not separate cache state. warm is a prefix or KV hit. cold is a miss or cache off. uncached is a prompt-processing rate with caching off or not used. mixed is one figure that combines hits and misses.

fields.name: cache_setup
fields.description: How the cache was configured: prefix cache, RAM or disk tier, engine flags. Empty if not stated.

fields.name: spec_decoding
fields.description: Speculative decoding method when stated, such as MTP, DSpark, or DFlash2. Empty if not stated or off.

fields.name: kv_pool_tokens
fields.description: KV cache pool capacity. Unit: tokens. Empty if not stated.

fields.name: cache_hit_ratio
fields.description: Share of prompt tokens served from cache, as a fraction from 0 to 1. 99% is stored as 0.99. Empty for a range or when only a recompute fraction was stated.

fields.name: cached_input_tokens
fields.description: Prompt tokens the source counted as cache reads. A cumulative counter when the note says so, not always one request. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: uncached_input_tokens
fields.description: Prompt tokens the source counted as processed without a cache hit. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Required. Ranges, approximations, and anything left empty are explained here.

resources.name: agentic_selftimed_steps
resources.description: Per-step timings that cloud coding agents took themselves (estimated, self-timed, including thinking and tool overhead). Not part of the sourced measurements table: no per-row source URL.

fields.name: platform
fields.description: Agent platform that ran the cell.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model name as the platform reported it.

fields.name: effort
fields.description: Effort setting of the session; default when the platform has none.

fields.name: cell
fields.description: Benchmark cell: context size and output length.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Context size label of the cell.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Output length label of the cell: short or long.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: One agent run (one model on one cell).

fields.name: branch
fields.description: Git branch the agent pushed to. Empty if none was recorded.

fields.name: step
fields.description: Step number in the protocol; a repeated step is flagged by dup_step.

fields.name: step_kind
fields.description: What the step did.

fields.name: t_before
fields.description: Unix time the agent took before the step. Unit: s. Self-timed.

fields.name: t_after
fields.description: Unix time the agent took after the step. Unit: s. Self-timed.

fields.name: duration_s
fields.description: t_after minus t_before. Unit: s. Includes model thinking and tool overhead; estimated, self-timed.

fields.name: read_bytes
fields.description: Bytes read in the step. Unit: bytes.

fields.name: read_tokens_est
fields.description: read_bytes / 4. Unit: tokens. An estimate, not a tokenizer count.

fields.name: write_bytes
fields.description: Bytes written in the step. Unit: bytes.

fields.name: write_tokens_est
fields.description: write_bytes / 4. Unit: tokens. An estimate, not a tokenizer count.

fields.name: dup_step
fields.description: True if the agent repeated this step number.

resources.name: claude_code_box_requests
resources.description: Per-request timings of Claude Code on a box, measured by a proxy with API token counts. Not part of the sourced measurements table: no per-row source URL.

fields.name: model_pinned
fields.description: Model the request pinned.

fields.name: model_served
fields.description: Model the API reported serving. Empty on failed requests.

fields.name: cell
fields.description: Cell: C0 to C3 are context-reuse cells, D is long decode; the suffix is the context size. Empty on one failed request.

fields.name: turn_index
fields.description: Turn within the session, from 1.

fields.name: input_tokens
fields.description: Uncached input tokens from the API usage. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: cache_creation_tokens
fields.description: Tokens written to the prompt cache. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: cache_read_tokens
fields.description: Tokens read from the prompt cache. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: output_tokens
fields.description: Output tokens from the API usage. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: prompt_tokens
fields.description: Total prompt tokens. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: new_tokens
fields.description: Prompt tokens not read from cache. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: cache_ratio
fields.description: Fraction of prompt tokens read from cache, 0 to 1.

fields.name: failure_class
fields.description: Failure class of the request; empty if it succeeded.

fields.name: ttft_ms
fields.description: Time to first token seen by the proxy. Unit: ms.

fields.name: ttft_text_ms
fields.description: Time to first text token seen by the proxy. Unit: ms.

fields.name: decode_window_ms
fields.description: Time between first and last token. Unit: ms.

fields.name: decode_tps
fields.description: Decode rate of the request, set only on long-decode cells. Unit: tok/s.

fields.name: turn_ms
fields.description: Whole request time. Unit: ms.

fields.name: t_send
fields.description: Send time since the start of the run. Unit: ms.

fields.name: excluded_reason
fields.description: Empty means the row is included in the analysis.

resources.name: inferencex_reference_points
resources.description: InferenceX agentic-coding reference points: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on 4x H200 (vLLM v0.32.0, FP4, MTP), run 39960029311, one row per concurrent session count.

fields.name: gen_per_session_tps
fields.description: output tok/s / sessions

fields.name: new_prefill_per_session_tps
fields.description: input tok/s x (1 - cache_rate) / sessions

fields.name: ingest_per_session_tps
fields.description: input tok/s / sessions

fields.name: inst_gen_median_tps
fields.description: per-request interactivity p50 (tok/s)

fields.name: inst_gen_p90_tps
fields.description: per-request interactivity at the p90 latency point (tok/s)

fields.name: cache_rate
fields.description: vLLM server overall prefix cache hit rate (server_metrics.cache.overall_cache_hit_rate)

fields.name: avg_context_k
fields.description: mean input tokens per request / 1000

fields.name: saturated
fields.description: True when the server is past saturation (N=128: cache hit collapses, median TTFT about 683 s, half the requests dropped as warmup). Kept in the overlay, drawn differently.

fields.name: source
fields.description: GitHub Actions run; values from its bmk_agentic_dsv41flash_tp4_* artifacts

resources.name: sonnet_concurrency_tiers
resources.description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 via the Anthropic Messages API, long-context agentic-style sessions, one row per concurrency tier (N concurrent sessions). Client-observed from a cloud box in Paris.

fields.name: sessions
fields.description: concurrent sessions in the tier (N)

fields.name: gen_per_session_tps
fields.description: output tok/s over the tier window / sessions (output includes thinking tokens)

fields.name: new_prefill_per_session_tps
fields.description: (uncached input + cache-write) tok/s over the tier window / sessions

fields.name: ingest_per_session_tps
fields.description: all prompt tok/s (input + cache-write + cache-read) over the tier window / sessions

fields.name: inst_gen_median_tps
fields.description: median of per-call decode tok/s (output tokens / (last delta - first delta))

fields.name: inst_gen_p90_tps
fields.description: 10th percentile of per-call decode tok/s, i.e. the slow tail

fields.name: cache_rate
fields.description: cache-read tokens / all prompt tokens

fields.name: avg_context_k
fields.description: mean prompt tokens per request / 1000

fields.name: ttft_median_ms
fields.description: median time to first streamed content delta (includes thinking)

fields.name: ttft_p90_ms
fields.description: 90th percentile of time to first streamed content delta

fields.name: http_429
fields.description: HTTP 429 responses received

fields.name: http_other_errors
fields.description: Attempts that failed without an HTTP status (dropped stream or connection) and were retried with backoff.

fields.name: output_tokens
fields.description: includes thinking tokens

fields.name: window_s
fields.description: first request sent to last response finished

fields.name: start_paris
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, Europe/Paris offset

fields.name: end_paris
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, Europe/Paris offset

fields.name: saturated
fields.description: True when the tier hit persistent 429s and was stopped early

resources.name: sonnet_concurrency_calls
resources.description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 concurrency sweep, one row per API call (including retried attempts), with timings, token counts and cost.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: concurrent sessions in the tier (N)

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: retry index, 0 for the first try

fields.name: t_send_unix
fields.description: unix seconds

fields.name: t_first_event_unix
fields.description: unix seconds

fields.name: t_first_text_unix
fields.description: unix seconds

fields.name: t_last_delta_unix
fields.description: unix seconds

fields.name: t_done_unix
fields.description: unix seconds

fields.name: ttft_ms
fields.description: send to first streamed content delta (includes thinking)

fields.name: ttft_text_ms
fields.description: send to first text delta

fields.name: decode_window_ms
fields.description: last delta - first delta

fields.name: inst_gen_tps
fields.description: output_tokens / decode window, tok/s

fields.name: input_tokens
fields.description: uncached input tokens

fields.name: output_tokens
fields.description: includes thinking tokens

fields.name: prompt_tokens
fields.description: input + cache-creation + cache-read tokens

fields.name: new_prefill_tokens
fields.description: input + cache-creation tokens

fields.name: itpm_remaining
fields.description: rate-limit header: input tokens per minute remaining

fields.name: otpm_remaining
fields.description: rate-limit header: output tokens per minute remaining
